# Erdős Problem 1134 (lower density of the set generated by 2x + 1, 3x + 1, 6x + 1)

The statement that the Klarner set has positive lower density ($\liminf_N |A \cap [0, N)|/N > 0$), where the Klarner set is the smallest set of natural numbers that contains $1$ and is closed under $x \mapsto 2x+1$, $x \mapsto 3x+1$ and $x \mapsto 6x+1$.

This page records the statement as a proposition. Its refutation: [The Klarner set has lower density zero](klarner-set-positive-lower-density-refut.md).

## Sources

- T. F. Bloom, Erdős Problems, Problem #1134, https://www.erdosproblems.com/1134.
